Class SocketClientHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am31.am31.network.socket.server.SocketClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualView
public class SocketClientHandler extends Object implements VirtualView
Server-side handler for a single socket client; implements VirtualView so the server can push updates and errors over the TCP stream
